paperTitle: Porting and Enhancing a Mental Health Narrative Game to Meta Quest 2 VR
centralContribution: This paper details the intricate process of porting and significantly enhancing a mental health narrative desktop game to the Meta Quest 2 VR platform, introducing novel features and optimizations to leverage VR's immersive capabilities. The work provides a comprehensive roadmap and valuable insights for future VR game design and development, focusing on performance, comfort, safety, interaction, and immersion to promote mental health awareness effectively.

elements.name: Paper Abstract
elements.description: Virtual Reality (VR), especially standalone devices like Meta Quest 2, offers immense potential for addressing global health challenges like depression. While games can foster mental health awareness, adapting existing desktop interactive narratives to VR presents significant challenges, including preventing motion sickness, designing intuitive 3D interactions, ensuring realistic embodiment, and overcoming hardware limitations. This paper addresses these complexities by detailing the porting and enhancement of a mental health narrative game to VR.
elements.justification: This element provides the essential context, problem statement, and a summary of the paper's approach, which is crucial for understanding the entire work.

elements.name: Core Contribution
elements.description: The paper describes the detailed process of porting and significantly enhancing a mental health narrative desktop game to the Meta Quest 2 VR platform. It highlights the introduction of novel features and optimizations specifically designed to leverage VR's immersive capabilities, providing a comprehensive roadmap and valuable insights for future VR game design and development focused on performance, comfort, safety, interaction, and immersion for effective mental health awareness.
elements.justification: This element directly states the central innovation and achievement of the paper, defining its primary purpose and impact.

elements.name: Meta Quest 2 Controller Mappings (FIG2.png)
elements.description: Figure 2 illustrates the Meta Quest 2 VR headset and its controllers, detailing the button mappings (A/B for emergency pause/exit, C for movement/rotation, D for Oculus system, E for object interaction, F for grasping) used to enable 6 Degrees of Freedom (6DoF) interactions within the VR game.
elements.justification: This figure is fundamental as it depicts the primary human-computer interaction interface for the VR game, directly supporting the 'Interaction Design' aspect of the method and the core goal of leveraging VR's immersive capabilities.

elements.name: Mental Health Level System Illustration (Made Bed) (FIG6.png)
elements.description: Figure 6 displays an in-game scene of a neatly made bed, symbolizing the game's core mechanic where positive habits (like making the bed) increase the protagonist's mental health level and reduce the antagonist's size. This visually represents the therapeutic gameplay loop directly linked to mental well-being.
elements.justification: This image directly showcases a fundamental gameplay mechanic tied to the paper's core theme of mental health awareness and improvement through interactive narratives.

elements.name: Accelerated In-Game Time Progression (FIG4.png)
elements.description: Figure 4 presents a series of screenshots showing the progression of an accelerated in-game day-night cycle, from 5 AM to 8 PM. This system simulates time, adjusting skybox illumination and contributing to the game's immersive environment.
elements.justification: This image highlights a dynamic environmental feature that significantly contributes to realism and immersion, directly supporting the enhanced VR experience and the paper's focus on optimized immersion.

elements.name: Integrated 3D UI and Dialogue System (FIG3.png)
elements.description: Figure 3 shows various in-game text messages and dialogue boxes integrated into the 3D game space. This demonstrates the UI overhaul, where UI elements float and follow the player's head movement using linear interpolation for an immersive experience without distraction.
elements.justification: This image illustrates a significant improvement in user interface design for VR, enhancing immersion and aligning with the paper's focus on optimal user experience in the ported game.

elements.name: DALL-E Generated Wall Painting (FIG13.png)
elements.description: Figure 13 displays an in-game wall painting generated using DALL-E generative AI from the prompt 'Blue and red butterflies feeling depressed, but still holding hope (Salvador Dalí style, on a light grey background)'. This showcases the integration of AI-generated art for dynamic environmental content.
elements.justification: This image demonstrates an innovative use of generative AI to create dynamic and narrative-specific environmental art, directly contributing to the 'novel features' mentioned in the central contribution.

elements.name: In-Game Guidance and Object Highlighting (FIG10.png)
elements.description: Figure 10 depicts an in-game scene with blue arrows indicating navigation paths and a depression medicine bottle highlighted on the toilet floor, alongside an antagonist character. This illustrates the guidance system designed to direct players to interactive elements and target locations.
elements.justification: This image shows a key mechanism for player guidance and interaction within the game, vital for narrative progression and achieving game objectives in the VR environment.

elements.name: Interactive Drawing System (FIG12.png)
elements.description: Figure 12 shows the protagonist interacting with a 'drawable object,' specifically writing 'SVR 2023' on a virtual canvas using an in-game brush tool. This highlights an innovative feature for player agency and creative expression within the VR environment.
elements.justification: This image illustrates a unique and advanced interactive feature that enhances player agency and immersion, aligning with the paper's focus on novel VR interactions.

elements.name: Object Colliders for Interaction (FIG5.png)
elements.description: Figure 5 visually represents or highlights the colliders applied to various interactable objects within the game scene. This demonstrates a fundamental technical aspect enabling physical interaction and collision detection in the VR environment, crucial for player engagement.
elements.justification: This image depicts a foundational technical detail critical for enabling realistic object interactions, which is a key component of the enhanced VR experience described in the paper.
